title: ProcessSyncedData
description: Data of the process.synced event: a synchronization of the process received, sent or restored something, or met a conflict; a change made on another machine is known by it. The event has no project.

received.description: Kinds changed on another machine and taken.

sent.description: Kinds changed on this machine and sent.

conflicts.description: Kinds changed on both machines that could not be brought together.

restored.description: Kinds changed around Gentry with problems, restored to the last checked variant.
